system_texts: The remote control is likely to be dropped and broken due to frequent handling, raising durability concerns.
A touchscreen on the remote could be fragile and not kid-friendly, raising durability and usability concerns.
Size and form-factor constraints are unclear, with multiple design options discussed (not too big, not too small, fold-open concept to see more options).
(resolved) Laptop issues during the session were encountered but resolved.
gold_texts: The group had some difficulties setting up their computers and using the smartboard.
The group leaned toward standard batteries, with a recharging home station sold separately as an option, but did not know what the station would cost.

The group discussed ways in which they could make the remote look unique but could not decide if the remote should have a unique folding-open design or if it should be made in a more standard, square shape.
